description: This Java class provides utility methods for performing MongoDB operations asynchronously, including dropping collections and deleting documents by filter, leveraging the Reactive Streams driver and Akka Streams.

classes.name: MongoOpsUtil
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for performing asynchronous MongoDB operations such as dropping collections and deleting documents using reactive streams and Akka.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Returns a reactive source that drops the specified MongoDB collection asynchronously, emitting a list of throwables if any occur.

methods.name: deleteByFilter
methods.description: Returns a reactive source that deletes documents matching the provided filter from the specified MongoDB collection, emitting a list of throwables if any occur.
